parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.label: ☁️ Customer
parameters.description: Select a subscription grouped by Azure Lighthouse customer directory
parameters.query:
// ======================================================================
// Customer Info - Customer / Subscription Selector
// ======================================================================

resources
| where type =~ "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces"
| summarize by subscriptionId

| join kind=leftouter
(
    ManagedServicesResources
    | where type =~ "microsoft.managedservices/registrationassignments"
    | extend Directory = coalesce(
        tostring(properties.registrationDefinition.properties.manageeTenantName),
        tostring(properties.manageeTenantName)
    )
    | extend Directory = trim(@"[^\w\s\.-]+", Directory)
    | where isnotempty(Directory)
    | summarize Directory = any(Directory) by subscriptionId
)
on subscriptionId

| extend SubscriptionResourceId = strcat("/subscriptions/", subscriptionId)
| extend selected = subscriptionId =~ "{DefaultSubscription_Internal}"
| extend group = iff(isnotempty(Directory), Directory, "Local / Other")
| project SubscriptionResourceId, selected, group
| distinct SubscriptionResourceId, selected, group
| order by group asc, SubscriptionResourceId asc

| order by label asc

content.json:
# Change Log

| Version | Changes |
|---|---|
| **v1.0** | Added **Microsoft Licensing & Account Governance** reporting. |
| | Added Microsoft Graph tenant-context validation to compare the active Graph directory with the selected Sentinel workspace tenant. |
| | Graph-based licensing and directory reports are automatically hidden when a tenant mismatch is detected. |
| | Added **Microsoft Licence Usage** using current `subscribedSkus` data from Microsoft Graph. |
| | Added an embedded **Microsoft SKU catalogue**, removing the runtime dependency on an external licensing CSV. |
| | Added short licence names and security-oriented SKU classification. |
| | Added separate **All**, **Security**, and **General** licence usage views. |
| | Added licence selection and **assigned-user drill-down** for individual SKUs. |
| | Added **Licence & Activity Reconciliation**, combining current Entra ID Member/licence state with successful interactive sign-in activity observed in Sentinel over the last 90 days. |
| | Added Licensed/Unlicensed and 30/90-day activity classifications to support account and licence review. |

# 🔐 Microsoft Licensing & Account Governance

This workbook provides a high-level view of **Microsoft licence allocation, security-related licence coverage and account activity**, combining Microsoft Graph directory information with Microsoft Sentinel telemetry where applicable.

## 🌐 Microsoft Graph Tenant Context

Licence and directory information is retrieved from the **Microsoft Graph directory available to the signed-in user**.

The workbook compares this directory with the Entra tenant associated with the selected Sentinel workspace:

- ✅ **Tenant Match** — Graph-based licensing and reconciliation reports are displayed.
- ⚠️ **Tenant Mismatch** — Graph-based reports are hidden to prevent information from another tenant being interpreted as belonging to the selected workspace.

> **Important:** Selecting a Sentinel workspace does not automatically change the Microsoft Graph directory used by your current session.

## 📦 Microsoft Licence Usage

The licence views use Microsoft Graph `subscribedSkus` data to show the licences available in the current directory and their assigned-user counts.

The embedded Microsoft SKU catalogue provides shorter product names and classifies licences into:

- 🛡 **Security / Identity** — dedicated identity, endpoint, threat protection, compliance and related security products.
- 🔐 **Security-capable suite** — Microsoft 365 and other suites classified as security-relevant by this workbook.
- 📦 **General / Other** — productivity, collaboration, voice, Power Platform and other licences not classified as security-related.

The workbook provides separate views for:

- **All Microsoft Licences** — overall licence distribution.
- **Security Licence Usage** — licences classified as security-relevant.
- **General Licence Usage** — licences not currently classified as security-relevant.

Select a licence from the detailed licence table to view the **users currently assigned that SKU**.

> ℹ️ **Classification:** The security classification is a workbook reporting aid rather than a Microsoft licensing or entitlement assessment. SKU names and classifications may change as Microsoft licensing evolves.

## 🔎 Licence & Activity Reconciliation

This view combines **current Microsoft Entra ID Member and licence state from Microsoft Graph** with **successful interactive sign-in activity observed in Microsoft Sentinel during the last 90 days**.

Activity is grouped as:

- 🟢 **Seen in last 30 days**
- 🔵 **Seen in 31–90 days**
- 💤 **Not seen in 90 days**

Licence state is shown separately as:

- 🔑 **Licensed**
- ⚪ **Unlicensed**

> ⚠️ **Interpretation:** “Not seen in 90 days” does not necessarily mean an account or licence is unused. Activity may occur outside the selected Sentinel workspace, through non-interactive authentication, or through services not represented by this dataset. Treat these identities as **candidates for review**, not automatically as licences to remove.

## 🛡️ Data Requirements

Microsoft Graph access is required for licence and directory information. Sentinel `SigninLogs` are required for the licence/activity reconciliation view.

Availability of Graph data depends on the permissions available to the signed-in user. Sentinel activity results depend on the selected workspace, available telemetry and retention.

> **Recommended:** Use this workbook from **Microsoft Defender → Microsoft Sentinel → Workbooks**, where the required Microsoft Graph workbook capabilities are available.

## 🔐 Microsoft Licensing & Account Governance

> ⚠️ **Defender Portal Recommended**  
> These reports use Microsoft Graph capabilities available in **security.microsoft.com**. Graph-based views may not function in the Azure / Microsoft Sentinel portal.

> 🌐 **Check the Microsoft Graph tenant status below.**  
> Licence and directory reports use the Entra tenant available to your current Microsoft Graph session. If it does not match the selected Sentinel workspace tenant, Graph-based reports are hidden to prevent cross-tenant interpretation.

Review **Microsoft licence allocation, security-related licence coverage and account activity** using current Microsoft Graph directory information and Sentinel sign-in telemetry.

The licence views separate the tenant's subscribed SKUs into **All Licences**, **Security-related Licences**, and **General Licences**. Select a licence from the detailed table to view its currently assigned users.

The reconciliation view then compares current licence state with observed interactive sign-in activity to highlight **licensed accounts with limited recent activity, active unlicensed identities, and disabled accounts retaining licence assignments**.

> ℹ️ Licence security classifications are provided as a workbook reporting aid and should not be interpreted as a definitive Microsoft licensing or security entitlement assessment.

ResourceContainers
| where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
| where subscriptionId =~ "{ws:subscriptionid}"

parameters.name: GraphTenantMatch
parameters.label: Graph Tenant Match
parameters.query:
ResourceContainers
| where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
| where subscriptionId =~ "{ws:subscriptionid}"
| extend WorkspaceTenantId = tolower(tostring(tenantId))
| extend GraphTenantId = tolower("{GraphTenantId}")
| project GraphTenantMatch = iff(isnotempty(GraphTenantId) and WorkspaceTenantId == GraphTenantId, "Match", "Mismatch")
| take 1

## 🔎 Licence & Activity Reconciliation

This view compares **current Microsoft Entra ID Member and licence state from Microsoft Graph** with **successful interactive sign-in activity observed in Microsoft Sentinel during the last 90 days**.

> ℹ️ **How to read this report**  
> **Licence status** reflects the current Microsoft Graph directory state.  
> **Activity status** reflects successful interactive sign-ins observed in the selected Sentinel workspace.  
> The grouped reconciliation table combines these datasets using the **Entra User ID**.

### 📊 Reconciliation Categories

- 🟢 **Seen in last 30 days** — successful interactive sign-in observed within the last 30 days.
- 🔵 **Seen in 31–90 days** — activity was observed during the 90-day period, but not within the last 30 days.
- 💤 **Not seen in 90 days** — no matching successful interactive sign-in was observed during the last 90 days.

The activity categories are **mutually exclusive**, so each licence group reconciles to its total:

**Licensed Members = Seen in last 30 days + Seen in 31–90 days + Not seen in 90 days**

The same reconciliation applies to **Unlicensed Members**.

> ⚠️ **Interpretation**  
> “Not seen in 90 days” does not necessarily mean an account or licence is unused. Activity may occur outside the selected Sentinel workspace, through non-interactive authentication, or through services not represented by this interactive sign-in dataset. Treat these identities as **candidates for review**, not automatically as licences to remove.

## 🔎 Licence & Activity Reconciliation
Combines current Microsoft Entra ID Member and licence state from Microsoft Graph with successful Microsoft Entra ID sign-in activity observed in Sentinel. **Licence state is current; activity is based on the last 90 days.**

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(90d)
| where ResultType == 0

| extend UPN = tolower(tostring(UserPrincipalName))
| where isnotempty(UPN)

// Exclude conventionally named service accounts
| where not(UPN startswith "svc")

// Graph /users.id maps directly to SigninLogs.UserId
| extend UserKey = tolower(tostring(UserId))
| where isnotempty(UserKey)

| summarize
    InteractiveSignIns90Days = count(),
    FirstInteractiveSignIn = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastInteractiveSignIn = max(TimeGenerated),
    ActivityUPN = take_any(UPN)
  by UserKey

| extend
    SeenLast30Days = iff(LastInteractiveSignIn >= ago(30d), "Yes", "No"),
    SeenLast90Days = "Yes"

| project
    UserKey,
    ActivityUPN,
    SeenLast30Days,
    SeenLast90Days,
    InteractiveSignIns90Days,
    FirstInteractiveSignIn,
    LastInteractiveSignIn

| order by LastInteractiveSignIn desc
